ConsentTab.title: Faster filtering, less work for your device
ConsentTab.intro: Browsers share what they find, so each image and video is checked once, not on every device. It helps most on older computers and phones.
ConsentTab.getBody: Masks other devices already made hide an image or video right away, without your device working it out again.
ConsentTab.shareMasks: $1: which parts of an image or video to hide. Masks already made on this device are included.
ConsentTab.shareAddress: The address of the image or video, to find or share its mask, and the site it was seen on.
ConsentTab.shareId: A random ID, to prevent abuse. No name, no account.
ConsentTab.shareReview: Shared masks and their images may be reviewed to improve detection.
ConsentTab.neverSentBody: The address of the page, anything from private windows, anything stored on your computer or your own network.
ConsentTab.closing: Only browsers that share get masks from others. Never sold, no ads. Turn it off any time in Options. $1
ConsentTab.eitherWay: HaramBlock keeps working on your device either way.

Options.neverAgreedIntro: A faster HaramBlock, with less work for your device: get masks other devices already made, and share yours.
Options.neverAgreedShare: $1 the masks your device makes, including ones already made, the address of the image or video and the site it was seen on, your manual masking choices, and a random ID to prevent abuse. Shared masks and their images may be reviewed to improve detection.
Options.neverAgreedNeverSent: $1 the address of the page, anything from private windows, anything stored on your computer or your own network.
Options.onSummary: This browser shares its masks and uses masks from others. $1
Options.onDeletion: Switching off stops sending at once. Reports already sent stay on the server. $1.
Options.offSummary: Off. Nothing is sent and no masks are fetched. Masks from others already on this device are used until they expire.
Options.offAgreement: Switching on is your agreement to send the data described in the $1, including media checked while this was off. Reports already sent stay on the server. $2.
